spec.name: Orange Kitchen Orange Juice
spec.description: A tall, stepped glass of vivid orange juice with a bent ivory straw and a fresh orange wheel tucked over the rim. Pale glass edges, a substantial foot and broad citrus shading keep the silhouette readable in inventory. Grounded at y=0; no cream.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Orange Juice. Tall stepped glass or paper milkshake cup, appropriate drink color, straw and whipped cream if the recipe calls for cream. Actual recipe ingredients: orange, water bottle. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
